name: polkit
description: Polkit is a toolkit for defining and handling authorizations. It is used for allowing unprivileged processes to communicate with privileged processes.

user:
meson setup build                  \
      --prefix=/usr              \
      --buildtype=release        \
      -D man=false               \
      -D session_tracking=logind \
      -D tests=false             \
      .

post_install: id -u polkitd >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -c "PolicyKit Daemon Owner" -d /etc/polkit-1 -u 27 -g polkitd -s /bin/false polkitd
